stops.note: to come to, to arrive, from ad- (to) and venire (to come)
settled in French for a tree-lined approach to a building
stops.meaning: a tree-lined approach to a building

stops.note: first a tree-lined approach to a country house; New York's numbered avenues were laid out in 1811

current_meaning: a broad street, especially one lined with trees, or a means of approach
